title: Recovery run
brief: We are attacking down your side. Watch what happens to the ball.
briefKid: We are attacking near you. Watch the ball.
question: We have lost it and their full-back is sprinting past you. Where do you go?
questionKid: Ball lost! Their defender runs past you. Where do you go?

takeaway.standard: When the ball is lost, sprint back toward our goal, not toward the ball, until you are goal-side of the player you are tracking.
takeaway.kid: We lose the ball? Sprint back toward our goal and beat your player back.

misconceptions.text: You drifted toward the ball, and their full-back ran into the space behind you.
misconceptions.textKid: Don't run to the ball. Run back and stay with your player.

misconceptions.text: You are still on the wrong side of their full-back; sprint back until you are between them and our goal.
misconceptions.textKid: You are behind your player, so sprint back past them.

notes: Engine answer since 2026-10-03 (it was authored: in engine mode a winger 3-7 m on the wrong side of their full-back scored 81-85, because goal-side weighs 1.5 for wingers and the winger zone is 6 m deep). The recovery rule (T3, R4: rules/recovery.js) now judges the side while we are recovering, critically past 1 m, and the tighter tolerance (2.5 x 4 m) is kept: the best spot (61, 58) scores 100, 2.5 m from the keyed ideal; level with the full-back scores 84, 3 m on the wrong side 59 (critical) and 7 m 15.
